# Keep the custom element tag, module and class names related

The current guide says a custom element name contains a hyphen, uses tb- when needed, and should have its own module whenever possible. The module filename matches the tag; the class uses PascalCase. Styles and Fluent files usually share the module basename. Named exports are needed when other elements extend the class. These are documented conventions for this element family. Older chrome-loaded .js widgets still exist, so this is not permission to rename every legacy widget mechanically. Static inspection supports this component scope. No runtime test was run for this lesson, and full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is still pending.

Scope: mail/custom-elements/naming.
